text:
sqlpipe v2.0 changes the `/v2/users` schema. The response no longer includes `name`. The API returns `first_name` and `last_name` instead. This is a breaking change. Before you upgrade, update clients that read `name`.

The CLI adds `--incremental`. Use this flag to process only new source rows after the last successful run. The run state stores the last processed position for each pipeline.

Parquet writes are 40% faster in this release. The writer uses larger batches and fewer memory copies. This change reduces export time for large datasets. Existing Parquet readers can read the output files.
